correctness.rationale: Coordinatewise abelianization has kernel (R')^T, which is contained in the derived subgroup by explicit compensated commutators. For the resulting abelian-base kernel, the homology exact sequence gives 0 -> T tensor T -> K_T -> ker(A -> T) -> 0, while lift commutators occupy exactly the alternating-tensor subgroup of order |wedge^2 T|. The resulting order simplifies to |R^ab||T||wedge^2 T|.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The recent source proves the kernel construction, its order, and preservation of abelian quotients but gives no abelianization or derived-subgroup formula. Standard full-wreath abelianization is prior art. Searches did not locate this coupled-kernel formula or its exterior-square correction; older literature under different terminology remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The formula upgrades quotient preservation to an exact first-derived-quotient invariant, isolates a Schur-multiplier correction for noncyclic targets, determines the derived-subgroup order, and gives exact abelianization growth throughout iterated kernel-wreath towers.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
